description: **`selfdoc baseline accept` works in the unified site's home project.** It registered none of the site-level directives (`projects-cards`, `blog-highlights`) that `check` resolves, so it refused every home page as carrying an unknown directive.

**Assembled project pages no longer link to the blog with absolute URLs.** The blog index link and post permalinks in a project's pages were written as `https://<site>/blog/...`, which the assembled-tree verification refuses because a clicked link must stay inside whatever mount the site is served from; they are document-relative now, so `assembly integrate` passes verification again.
